about.description: BiLira issues a fiat-backed stablecoin maintained at parity with its reference currency through reserve backing and redemption mechanisms. It enables fast, low-cost settlement of stablecoin transactions.
about.registryInfo: BiLira - issuer/brand of the TRYB Turkish lira stablecoin. Public documentation indicates TRYB is designed to track TRY via a centralized issuer model with offchain reserves; legal/entity disclosures depend on issuer-provided documentation.
